faqs.question: How do Medjool dates taste and feel?
faqs.answer: Medjool dates are distinctly large with a soft, moist flesh and a rich, honey-caramel flavor profile.

faqs.question: Why was the catalog name normalized?
faqs.answer: The catalog lists "Jordon Medjool Dates", which represents Jordan Medjool dates. We normalize the title while retaining the catalog reference for full traceability.
